entities.name: Jusuf Efendi Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jusuf Efendi Mosque was built in 1773 at a time when North Macedonia was a part of the Ottoman Empire. It was damaged in the 1963 earthquake and reconstructed in 1967.
